## About
A Quality Auto Body & Services is a fully licensed auto body and auto service repair facility on Perkins Place in Silver Spring. Our team is I-Car Gold Class trained and ASE Certified, and our commitment to honesty and perfection means the best quality of work at a reasonable price.
The shop is equipped to analyze, repair and refinish your vehicle: a fully computerized alignment system, computerized testing equipment, a computer controlled downdraft paint booth, frame machines and a spot welding machine. For paint, we use a computerized color imaging system and Spies Hecker paint made in Germany.
Customers know the shop through Mr. Chen. One reviewer wrote that he "always goes the extra mile to help his customers," and another said Mr. Chen and his crew repaired their vehicle in a timely manner.

## Services
- Full Collision Repair: Body work, frame repair and refinishing, with frame machines, spot welding and a downdraft paint booth in the shop.
- Engine & Brake Repairs: Diagnosis and repair of engines and brakes, using computerized testing equipment.
- Four Wheel Alignment: Alignment done on a fully computerized alignment system.
- Check Engine Light Diagnostics: We find out why the light is on before recommending any work.
- Toyota Prius Repairs: Repair work on the Toyota Prius, a specialty of the shop.
- Diagnose with Original Toyota Scanner: For Toyota automobiles, diagnostics are run with an original Toyota scanner.
- Major & Minor Repairs: From routine maintenance and tune-ups to bigger mechanical jobs like water pumps, timing belts and transmission work.
- Free Estimates: Call the shop for a free estimate. Our computerized estimating system makes the work easier, faster and cheaper.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance claims?
A: Yes. We welcome insurance claims and provide discounts, and we will help you negotiate with your insurance company.

Q: What if my insurance requires after market parts?
A: We will let you know if your policy requires them, and it is up to you whether to use them. If the after market parts are not up to our standards, we will not use them.

Q: My car is not drivable. Can you help?
A: Yes. We will help you find a tow truck to get your car to the shop.

Q: How do I get to and from the shop while my car is here?
A: We offer pick up and drop off at the Forest Glen red line metro station.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. One reviewer was glad the shop was open on a Saturday after a weekend dent.
